behaviors.description: Complete mandatory basic authentication with validated credentials.
expected: Exact remote and realm, real callback ID completion, token-bearing payload download and exact deployment.
Service rejects wrong password; transaction fails without payload transfer or installation.

behaviors.description: Decline basic authentication and separately complete with NULL user.
expected: Both paths send Close, fail the transaction and leave payload unfetched and installation empty.

behaviors.description: Webflow completion with invalid and valid HTTP login credentials.
expected: Both outcomes emit real webflow-done with matching ID; only valid login releases token and deploys protected commit.

behaviors.description: Decline webflow and separately abort the accepted request by ID.
expected: Both paths send Close and fail before protected transfer or installation.

behaviors.description: Inspect a resolved token-requiring operation and decide whether authentication proceeds.
expected: Exact ref/commit requires authentication at pre-auth; FALSE precedes service request; TRUE completes authentication and ready sees resolved authenticated operation.

behaviors.description: Propagate X11 and Wayland parent identifiers to external authenticator.
expected: Initial getter NULL, both identifiers roundtrip and arrive exactly on public wire; protected installations succeed.

mappings.rationale: Real basic-auth callback validates remote/realm and completes active ID; independent service validates credentials before returning token; ready inspects exact authenticated ref/commit and HTTP verifies token-bearing payload before exact deployment.
Separate transactions return FALSE and complete with NULL user; public service observes Close, run fails with GError, zero protected requests and no deployment.

Real start callback follows supplied loopback URL; server validates HTTP login credential. Failed and successful logins both produce matching-ID done callbacks. Only successful login returns download token and deploys exact commit.
Separate transactions decline start and abort accepted active ID. Both cause public Close, failed run with GError and no protected transfer or deployment.

Pre-auth callback checks sole exact ref/commit and TRUE requires-authentication. Refusal causes no service request; acceptance authenticates, reaches ready with FALSE requires-authentication and installs exact protected commit.
Fresh transaction getter NULL, X11 and Wayland setter/getter checks, independent service asserts exact parent argument for each successful protected install.
